items.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.one_liner: Beautiful diagram library for AI coding agents
items.pain_point: AI agents generate ugly Mermaid diagrams; developers and technical writers need publication-quality diagrams for docs and specs but have no clean tooling
app_ideas: Web-based diagram studio with 29 types + export to HTML/SVG/PNG, targeting devs who write docs
Obsidian/Notion plugin rendering these diagrams inline with live preview
Diagram API service: send text prompt, get back self-contained SVG/HTML diagram for B2B dev tool vendors
items.monetization: Freemium web app + B2B API wrapper (teams pay for hosted rendering, higher rate limits, team libraries)
items.why_now: Claude Code and AI coding agents are exploding (388% weekly star growth) and all need documentation/diagram generation tooling that doesn't exist yet
